verdict.rationale: YPOG's own materials show it advises both founders/startups and PE/VC funds/investors across financing transactions, funds structuring, and market-standard terms briefings (e.g. venture deals guide covering 'market-standard investment terms', explicit VC ecosystem network claims, and funds-side market-leader positioning), indicating dual-side market knowledge. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration (e.g. rankings, client testimonials from both fund and founder side) and no explicit case study showing simultaneous representation of both an investor and a portfolio company in the same deal.
